name: AerioTV Presets
description: Preconfigure a user's AerioTV favorites, group order, hidden groups, and settings. Their AerioTV devices offer Dispatcharr Sync on first launch and start from this setup. Requires AerioTV 1.8.45 or newer on Apple devices and AerioTV for Android 0.5.14 or newer.
author: jonzey231

fields.label: How it works
fields.description:
1. Choose a user and Save.
2. Run Refresh Lists, then reload this page. Do this again after switching users.
3. Open each section and make your choices. Anything left on Leave empty or Leave as is is skipped.
4. Save.
5. Run Preview to see what would change. Preview writes nothing.
6. In Apply, pick Fill to add only what the record does not have yet, or Replace to overwrite what you set here. Run Apply and confirm.

fields.label: User
fields.help_text: The Dispatcharr user whose AerioTV setup this writes. Becomes a list of users once the plugin has loaded.

options.label: Fill: only add what the record does not have yet
Replace: overwrite the sections you set here

actions.label: Refresh Lists
actions.description: Rebuilds the lists for the chosen user. Save first, then reload the page.

actions.label: Preview
actions.description: Shows what Apply would change, without writing.

actions.label: Apply
actions.description: Writes the setup to the user's AerioTV record.

confirm.title: Apply AerioTV setup?
confirm.message: This writes the user's AerioTV record. Replace mode overwrites what their devices saved for the sections you filled in.

actions.label: Clear Record
actions.description: Deletes the chosen User's AerioTV sync record on this server. It removes only that record; Dispatcharr data and the apps on devices are not touched.

confirm.title: Clear the AerioTV record?
confirm.message: This deletes the chosen User's AerioTV sync record on this server. It cannot be undone. Their devices keep what they have and write a new record on their next sync.
